title: DHIS2 Clinic Selector
description: A switcher for the clinic a user is working in: a short list of their own organisation units, with search when they have more.
docs: Wrap the app in ClinicProvider and put ClinicSelector at the top of the app's navigation, on a light surface. The block brings no navigation of its own, so pass collapsed yourself when yours is narrowed to icons. Read useClinic() on any page to scope its data to the current clinic. Pass value and onValueChange to ClinicProvider to control the choice, for example from the URL. Set label and searchPlaceholder when your users call clinics facilities or sites. For a tree picker of any organisation unit, use context-selector instead.
